newsitem.title: SWEDEN: James Capel downgrades Stora to sell.
newsitem.headline: James Capel downgrades Stora to sell.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said in a report on Swedish forestry group Stora that it downgraded the company to sell.
"Time to take profits -- expect H2 and 1997 to disappoint," James Capel said.
Capel said Stora's first half results were worse than expected and the investment bank said it had reduced its 1996 pre-tax profit forecast to 2.97 billion crowns compared with 1995's 8.02 billion.

"H1 1996 was one of the worst in Stora's history and made a stark contrast with one of the best in H1 1995...any optimism for the second half was guarded and management would not be drawn into speculation on the outlook for 1997." -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
